cases.purpose: Multiple selected resources preserve the documented single-resource text and raw rows in resource order, including duplicate selectors.
cases.script:
for mode in text raw; do
  opts=(); [[ $mode == raw ]] && opts=(--raw --noheadings)
  { prlimit "${opts[@]}" --core; prlimit "${opts[@]}" --nofile; prlimit "${opts[@]}" --stack; } > expected
  prlimit "${opts[@]}" --stack --core --nofile --core > actual || exit 1
  cmp -s expected actual || exit 2
done
printf 'selected rows match\n'
cases.oracle: Metamorphic composition of individually queried rows; historical kernel-backed and util-linux-adapted cases independently validate individual rows.

cases.purpose: Multiple selected resources produce the existing JSON collection shape with correct ordered values for the same PID.
cases.script:
prlimit --json --pid "$BASHPID" --stack --core --nofile > many || exit 1
for name in CORE NOFILE STACK; do prlimit --json --pid "$BASHPID" -r "$name" >> singles || exit 2; done
/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import json,sys; a=json.load(open("many")); b=[json.loads(x) for x in open("singles")]; assert a == {"pid":int(sys.argv[1]),"limits":b}; print("selected json matches")' "$BASHPID"
cases.oracle: Metamorphic composition of individual JSON records; historical /proc-backed cases independently validate their values.

cases.purpose: Multiple resource selectors cannot accidentally apply a limit to one resource.
cases.script:
before=$(prlimit --raw --noheadings --nofile) || exit 1
prlimit --core --nofile=1 > out 2> err; rc=$?
after=$(prlimit --raw --noheadings --nofile) || exit 2
[[ $rc != 0 && ! -s out && -s err && $before == "$after" ]] || exit 3
printf 'multi-set rejected unchanged\n'
cases.oracle: A rejected ambiguous set must leave the independently queried NOFILE limit unchanged.
